free_text_notes.physician_note: 73-year-old woman with asthma, dementia (mild), admitted 6/20 with aspiration pneumonia, improving. Leukocytosis resolved; tolerating diet.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. The patient experienced a fall at home approximately six months ago. There have been no falls during this admission. Home safety was assessed and no concerns were identified. The patient practices fasting for religious reasons on certain days of the week. The clinical team was made aware and confirmed this does not conflict with the medication schedule.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Discharge planning in progress; CM following daily. 6/25 18:00: Per pharmacy, insulin glargine changed from 20 units nightly to 14 units nightly. No documentation that the patient or family has been informed of the new dose. Radiology read on the repeat chest X-ray still pending. Patient asked to move the PCP appointment; rebooked within 7 days of discharge.
